style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2, modern everyday setting, original people in present-day casual clothes. NO text, letters, numerals, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Communicate the specific meaning through clear actions and relationships, suitable for elementary-school readers and mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass greens, pale sky blues, warm earthy browns, plenty of ivory breathing room. No flat digital color blocks, no glossy shading, no 3D, no imitation of any named artist. Scene:
scene_prompt: Modern neighborhood birthday gathering. A normally plainly dressed adult guest humorously joins a brief make-believe game just to match cheerful occasion: he loosely wears a crooked cardboard crown and holds a cardboard spoon as pretend royal scepter, playfully bows to children wearing simple animal paper masks. Everyone laughs, casual ordinary party setting with borrowed props from an open costume box, no real theater stage or serious audience. A small soft-edged next-moment inset shows same guest has set crown and spoon back in box and cheerfully returns to helping carry plates in regular clothes, making clear temporary playful participation rather than a real title or profession. No readable party banner birthday numbers or branding. Natural two arms per person, five fingers, realistic light cardboard props grip and poses. 3:2 landscape graphite watercolor colored-pencil ivory paper, no text letters logos watermarks.
alt: 聚會來賓臨時戴上歪紙冠、拿紙湯匙陪孩子扮國王逗笑，稍後便放回道具，回去幫忙端盤子。
